{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.24

|gr1= Arrays

|descr= Reverses given array by reference (modifies the original array, just like [[resize]]). The alternative syntax can be used to reverse a ANSI [[String|string]]. If Unicode support is desired, see [[forceUnicode]].

|s1= [[reverse]] array

|p1= array: [[Array]] of [[Anything]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|s2= [[reverse]] string
|s2since= arma3 2.02

|p21= string: [[String]] - string to be reversed

|r2= [[String]] - reversed string

|x1= <sqf>
_arr = [1,2,3];
reverse _arr;
hint str _arr; // [3,2,1]
</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
_wordArr = toArray "gateman";
reverse _wordArr;
hint toString _wordArr; // nametag
</sqf>

|x3= <sqf>reverse "treboR"; // Returns "Robert"</sqf>

|seealso= [[set]] [[resize]] [[select]] [[in]] [[find]] [[toArray]] [[toString]] [[forEach]] [[count]] [[pushBack]] [[pushBackUnique]] [[apply]] [[append]] [[sort]] [[param]] [[params]] [[arrayIntersect]] [[splitString]] [[joinString]] [[forceUnicode]]
}}
